_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description:
Choose your victory condition. You can choose one of the following:
- Defeat Dead King Freddy, the final Boss of POPGOES: The Dead Forest.
- Free Bonnie Glade from the arcade machine, first available after gaining access to the Dead Forest Castle and getting the secret key.
- 100% the game. This means unlocking all Abilities and Upgrades, maxing out your stats, collecting all Paints, freeing Bonnie, and then defeating Dead King Freddy.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
Add the Gilded Hat to your Starting Inventory and remove it from the item pool.
Add the Ribbon to your Starting Inventory and remove it from the item pool.
Toggle if Shop-related Checks will be automatically hinted at the start of the Multiworld.
These include Holly's Shop, BB's Black Market, and Manora's Upgrades.
Disable if you want the Items that are held in these places to be a mystery...
Add the pieces of the Blackrabbit to the item pool, add Checks for picking them up, and require them for content related to the Blackrabbit.
Add Checks for defeating Gilded Enemies.
WARNING: This is made an option because Gilded Enemies only have a 0.8% chance of spawning in their respective areas.
Enabling this could place mandatory items behind extremely rare checks.
ENABLE AT YOUR OWN DISCRETION.
(6 Checks)
Add Checks for the fruits that can be harvested from trees within the West, South, and East forests.
(18 Checks)
Add Checks for each of the six consumables that can be obtained via digging.
This setting is off by default because they're luck-based checks.
(6 Checks)
Add Checks for unboxing The Puppet's Battle Gifts.
This may be partially luck-based, but it's still enabled by default since you'll be doing lots of battles anyway.
(9 Checks)
Add Checks for completing each of the game's Achievements.
Some Achievements are disabled if other YAML Options are also disabled.
Be warned that some of these are either tedious, luck-based, difficult, or some combination of them.
Enabling these should only be done if you're confident in your ability to complete them all.
(25 Checks)
